description: RF baseline (published, Kostunin et al. ICRC 2021)
v1: DNN on flattened matrices + features
v6: CNN with channel attention + MLP
v8: Ensemble of v3, v4, v6
v9: Weighted ensemble (0.2 v3, 0.2 v4, 0.6 v6)
v19: CNN with CBAM (channel + spatial attention)
Final submission: v6 CNN with channel attention
Multi-seed ensemble: v6(seed42) + v20(seed43) + v21(seed44), averaged
Engineered features (Ne-Nmu, Ne+Nmu, squared diff, Ne*Nmu interaction)
Data augmentation: 90° rotations, flips, noise on matrices during training
Focal loss (gamma=2, alpha weights), downweights easy examples
SGD optimizer with momentum=0.9, nesterov=True, lr=0.01
